description:
Implement DataFrame (Polars, Pandas, PySpark, DataFusion) versions of all 136 Read
Primitives queries. This benchmark tests fundamental database read operations and is
the ideal candidate for DataFrame expansion - it uses the TPC-H schema (already
supported by DataFrame loaders) and covers operations that map well to DataFrame APIs.

The Read Primitives catalog includes queries across 29 categories:
- Aggregation (13 queries): COUNT, SUM, AVG, COUNT DISTINCT, GROUP BY
- Filter (10 queries): WHERE clauses, predicate pushdown
- Optimizer (13 queries): Subquery decorrelation, join reordering, constant folding
- Array (9 queries): ARRAY operations, UNNEST, array aggregations
- String (11 queries): LIKE, CONCAT, SUBSTRING, string functions
- Order By (8 queries): Sorting, TOP-N, ORDER BY ALL
- Window (6 queries): ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG/LEAD, aggregate windows
- Qualify (6 queries): QUALIFY clause for window filtering
- Shuffle (5 queries): Data redistribution patterns
- Group By (5 queries): GROUP BY ALL, GROUP BY ROLLUP/CUBE
- And 19 more categories with 1-4 queries each

Implementation follows the established TPC-H DataFrame pattern using:
- Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion): ctx.col(), ctx.lit(), lazy expressions
- Pandas family (Pandas, Modin, Dask, cuDF): df['column'], boolean indexing, eager ops
